name: signal-infowells
description: Independent reasoning and activation framework with an integrated skills marketplace and bounded autonomous build cycle. Not subordinated to PMCR-O or any other system.

plugins.name: siw-signal
plugins.description: Detect and prioritize candidate signals from a task. Does not rank truth.

plugins.name: siw-recognition
plugins.description: Surface continuous, unresolved Recognition events. Never treat recognition as finished.

plugins.name: siw-evidence
plugins.description: Seal observations into digests with provenance. Sealing is not promotion.

plugins.name: siw-execution
plugins.description: Execute under bounded recursive limits. Halting on bounds is correct protocol.

plugins.name: siw-validation
plugins.description: Independent validation gate. Never auto-promotes to CONFIRMED.

plugins.name: siw-provenance
plugins.description: Record chain of custody for claims and changes.

plugins.name: siw-status
plugins.description: Apply CONFIRMED / NOT-YET-VERIFIED / NOT-RUN without collapsing labels.

plugins.name: siw-baseline
plugins.description: Compare current sealed digest against a baseline. Match does not imply promotion.

plugins.name: siw-run-record
plugins.description: Emit a run-registry-shaped record for an activation cycle.

plugins.name: siw-refine
plugins.description: One bounded refinement proposal. Does not claim real-world improvement.

plugins.name: siw-echo
plugins.description: Minimal echo skill for marketplace smoke tests.

plugins.name: siw-task-digest
plugins.description: Canonical digest of the task description for registry and provenance.

plugins.name: siw-autonomous-build
plugins.description: Coordinate bounded framework and marketplace build cycles with automatic quality gates and command-gated promotion.

lifecycle: Record evidence, changes, and unresolved questions
